title: Bounded-below complexes admit bounded-below K-injective resolutions
statement: Let $(U,\mathcal O_U)$ be a ringed site with small underlying category [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], and let $\mathcal G^\bullet$ be a bounded-below cochain complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then there is a quasi-isomorphism $\mathcal G^\bullet\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ to a bounded-below cochain complex whose terms are injective $\mathcal O_U$-modules, and $\mathcal I^\bullet$ is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex].
